mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GEO marketing for an accounting firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results from GEO marketing for an accounting firm can vary. Initial improvements in local rankings and visibility might begin appearing within 2-4 months as search engines process optimizations to your Google Business Profile and website. However, achieving significant, sustained growth in client inquiries and truly dominant local search positions often takes 6-12 months or longer. Factors like competitive landscape, the current state of your online presence, and consistency of efforts all influence the speed of results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial GEO marketing results for accounting firms can be seen in 2-4 months, with significant growth often taking 6-12 months, depending on competitive factors and consistent effort.
